description: This file implements the ClientController class for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state transitions within the Rialto client component. It includes methods for registering/unregistering clients, initializing and terminating shared memory, and notifying clients of state changes.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Manages client registration, shared memory, and application state transitions within the Rialto client.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns the shared memory handle managed by the controller.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and retrieves the current application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory by obtaining a file descriptor and buffer length from the control IPC.

methods.name: termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates and resets the shared memory handle.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Changes the application state and notifies all registered clients.

methods.name: stateToString
methods.description: Converts an ApplicationState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Updates the current application state and notifies all registered clients.
